summary: One-frame request to play the looping instrument sound of a bard-instrument spell (sibling of ecl::sound::StartInstrumentSpellSoundRequestOneFrameComponent). Built by ecl::sound::SpellInstrumentSoundSystem::ProcessSpellRequest (Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x7F9580) into ComponentsToCreate (element stride 0x48) and copied into the component by bg3.exe+0x1A84C00. Never seen alive. Registry total 80 (client row).

fields.name: OriginatorPrototype
fields.evidence: Same members as Script Extender's eoc::spell::SpellId (Base/ExposedTypes.h: SpellMetaId + Prototype, 0x38 bytes); the game calls eoc::spell::SpellId::SpellId/~SpellId on +0x10 of the component.

fields.name: Prototype
fields.evidence: SE SpellId Prototype; Toolkit ProcessSpellRequest reads the spell prototype name at SpellId+0x30

fields.name: _Pad52
fields.evidence: padding to 0x38 (SpellId array stride 0x38 in ProcessSpellRequest)

fields.name: InstrumentType
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1A85260 (AllocRaw 0x50) writes byte 0. bg3.exe+0x1A84C00 copies element[0] (1 byte). Toolkit ProcessSpellRequest fills element[0] (local_e8) with the byte of a component read (FUN_1807f58d0) from the entity returned by eoc::equipment::GetEquipmentEntityInSlot - the equipped instrument; most likely eoc::stats::MusicalInstrumentComponent's 1-byte instrument type (EMusicalInstrumentType, uint8).

fields.name: Sound
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF at +4; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C2A60 DecRefs +4 in the global string table; bg3.exe+0x1A84C00 assigns element[4] with IncRef/DecRef. Toolkit: element[4] = eoc::SpellPrototype::GetFixedStringValue(prototype, <global field name>) or a default FixedString when empty - the sound event/name of the spell.

fields.name: HasSpell
fields.evidence: Creator writes byte 0 at +8. bg3.exe+0x1A84C00: `comp[8] = elem[0x40]; if (elem[0x40]) { construct SpellId at comp+0x10 from elem+8; comp[0x48] = 1; }`. Toolkit sets elem[0x40] (local_a8) from the bool parameter param_8 of ProcessSpellRequest.

fields.name: Spell
fields.evidence: Optional eoc::spell::SpellId storage: creator zeroes 0x10..0x47; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C2A60 runs eoc::spell::SpellId::~SpellId(p+0x10) when byte +0x48 is set; bg3.exe+0x1A84C00 copy-constructs it. Equals Script Extender's SpellId (0x38 bytes).

fields.name: SpellHasValue
fields.evidence: Optional flag: creator writes 0, destructor tests and clears +0x48, writer sets it to 1 after constructing the SpellId.
